Source-derived, edited excerpts from a supplied workflow for an **already
integrated** epithelial Seurat object. Its project attribution is not established;
this file is presented as a separate methods example. This notebook demonstrates CytoTRACE2
scoring, transfer to Monocle3, graph learning and pseudotime visualization. The
uploaded source did not implement integration or Harmony; neither is claimed here.

Study identifiers, experimental strata, group mappings, root-cell choices, selected
genes, comments describing findings and all results have been removed. No data or
rendered plots are included. This excerpt has not been rerun. Knitting displays
code only; manual execution requires authorized private inputs and package checks.

```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE, cache = FALSE)
```

## Existing integrated object

Run from the repository root. The unprovided object must contain an RNA assay,
log-normalized RNA expression, Seurat identities, `seurat_clusters` and UMAP
coordinates. Neutral metadata fields `analysis_group` and `stratum` replace the
original study fields. `epithelial-settings.rds` must provide a supported `species`,
two privately chosen `strata` and `plot_features`. No actual values are supplied.

```{r private-inputs}
epiintegrated <- readRDS("data/private/epithelial-integrated.rds")
analysis_settings <- readRDS("data/private/epithelial-settings.rds")
dir.create("outputs/private", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("analysis_group", "stratum", "seurat_clusters") %in%
                colnames(epiintegrated@meta.data)))
```

## CytoTRACE2

The source used RNA log-normalized expression. Its organism-specific default has
been replaced by an explicit private setting. Check the installed CytoTRACE2
version's input requirements, species and feature identifiers before execution.
The package reference retained from the source is
[digitalcytometry/cytotrace2](https://github.com/digitalcytometry/cytotrace2).

```{r cytotrace2-scoring}
library(CytoTRACE2)
expression_data <- GetAssayData(epiintegrated, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
cytotrace2_result <- cytotrace2(expression_data, species = analysis_settings$species)
```

```{r merge-scores}
meta <- epiintegrated@meta.data
meta <- meta %>% rownames_to_column("cell")
cytotrace2_result <- cytotrace2_result %>% rownames_to_column("cell")
meta <- left_join(meta, cytotrace2_result, by = "cell")
meta <- meta %>% column_to_rownames("cell")
epiintegrated@meta.data <- meta
```

## Score and category visualizations

These are plotting calls only. No potency category or ordering is asserted for
any study cells.

```{r score-visualization}
FeaturePlot(epiintegrated, features = "CytoTRACE2_Relative", split.by = "stratum") &
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C")
FeaturePlot(epiintegrated, features = "CytoTRACE2_Score", split.by = "stratum") &
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C")
DimPlot(object = epiintegrated, reduction = "umap", cols = colors,
        label = FALSE, group.by = "CytoTRACE2_Potency")
DimPlot(object = epiintegrated, reduction = "umap", cols = colors,
        label = FALSE, group.by = "preKNN_CytoTRACE2_Potency")
```

The original notebook examined separate strata. Selection now comes from private
settings; names and experimental meaning have been omitted.

```{r stratum-views}
epi_a <- subset(epiintegrated,
                cells = colnames(epiintegrated)[epiintegrated$stratum == analysis_settings$strata[1]])
epi_b <- subset(epiintegrated,
                cells = colnames(epiintegrated)[epiintegrated$stratum == analysis_settings$strata[2]])
FeaturePlot(epi_a, features = "CytoTRACE2_Relative", split.by = "analysis_group") &
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C")
DimPlot(object = epi_a, reduction = "umap", cols = colors, label = FALSE,
        split.by = "analysis_group", pt.size = 0.03)
FeaturePlot(epi_b, features = "CytoTRACE2_Relative", split.by = "analysis_group") &
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C")
DimPlot(object = epi_b, reduction = "umap", cols = colors, label = FALSE,
        split.by = "analysis_group", pt.size = 0.03)
saveRDS(epiintegrated, "outputs/private/epithelial-with-scores.rds")
```

## Monocle3 conversion

The source notebook credited this public
[Seurat and Monocle3 tutorial](https://rpubs.com/mahima_bose/Seurat_and_Monocle3_p)
for its Monocle3 conversion approach. The retained code explicitly transfers the
Seurat clustering and embedding; it does not re-estimate an integration.

```{r monocle-conversion}
library(monocle3)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(magrittr)

DefaultAssay(epiintegrated) <- "RNA"
cds <- as.cell_data_set(epiintegrated)
head(colData(cds))
rowData(cds)$gene_short_name <- rownames(cds)
head(rowData(cds))
head(counts(cds))
```

## Transfer clustering and coordinates

The source places all cells in one partition and calls `learn_graph` with
`use_partition = FALSE`. That is a retained analysis choice requiring review for
new data. Internal cluster assignments are package-version dependent.

```{r transfer-clusters}
recreate.partitions <- c(rep(1, ncol(cds)))
names(recreate.partitions) <- colnames(cds)
recreate.partitions <- as.factor(recreate.partitions)
cds@clusters[["UMAP"]][["partitions"]] <- recreate.partitions

list.cluster <- epiintegrated@active.ident
cds@clusters[["UMAP"]][["clusters"]] <- list.cluster
reducedDims(cds)[["UMAP"]] <- epiintegrated@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
Idents(epiintegrated) <- epiintegrated$seurat_clusters

cluster.before.traj <- plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "seurat_clusters",
                                  label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
                                  group_label_size = 5) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
cluster.before.traj
```

## Graph learning and manual root selection

```{r graph-learning}
cds <- learn_graph(cds, use_partition = FALSE)
plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "cluster", label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
           label_branch_points = TRUE, label_roots = TRUE, label_leaves = FALSE,
           group_label_size = 5)
```

The next call is interactive and requires a justified root choice. The original
root selection and its biological rationale have been removed. No replacement
root or direction is invented. Root choice affects interpretation of pseudotime.

```{r interactive-ordering}
cds <- order_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "pseudotime", label_groups_by_cluster = TRUE,
           label_branch_points = TRUE, label_roots = FALSE,
           label_leaves = FALSE, cell_size = 0.2)
```

## Pseudotime plots

```{r pseudotime-plots}
png("outputs/private/epithelial-trajectory.png", res = 300, height = 1000, width = 1500)
plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "pseudotime", label_groups_by_cluster = TRUE,
           label_branch_points = TRUE, label_roots = FALSE,
           label_leaves = FALSE, cell_size = 0.2)
dev.off()

cds$monocle3_pseudotime <- pseudotime(cds)
data.pseudo <- as.data.frame(colData(cds))
ggplot(data.pseudo, aes(monocle3_pseudotime, seurat_clusters,
                       fill = seurat_clusters)) + geom_boxplot()
png("outputs/private/pseudotime-by-cluster.png", res = 300, height = 1600, width = 1500)
ggplot(data.pseudo, aes(monocle3_pseudotime,
                       reorder(seurat_clusters, monocle3_pseudotime),
                       fill = seurat_clusters)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  geom_boxplot()
dev.off()
```

## Graph-associated genes and Seurat metadata

The gene list in the source contained unpublished analysis selections. It has
been replaced with an unprovided private panel. `graph_test` is preserved as a
method call; no association results are supplied.

```{r graph-associated-genes}
deg <- graph_test(cds, neighbor_graph = "principal_graph")
deg %>% arrange(q_value) %>% filter(status == "OK") %>% head()
FeaturePlot(epiintegrated, features = analysis_settings$plot_features)
epiintegrated$pseudotime <- pseudotime(cds)
png("outputs/private/pseudotime-on-umap.png", res = 300, height = 1000, width = 1500)
FeaturePlot(epiintegrated, features = "pseudotime")
dev.off()
saveRDS(epiintegrated, "outputs/private/epithelial-with-pseudotime.rds")
```

Small compatibility edits replace assay and feature-metadata slot access with
accessors and simplify cluster-list indexing. These edits have not been execution
tested. The SeuratWrappers/Monocle3 conversion, matrix scale and species setting
must be checked in the user's private environment before running the workflow.
